note: Hand-written stand-in for the map that packages/explorer-structure will generate. Only src/model/adapter.ts reads this file.

regions.label: Browser
regions.summary: The React app. It calls the app's functions over the Convex client, and holds the access token and the refresh token of its session.

regions.label: Another holder
regions.summary: Whoever presents a copy of a refresh token that the browser already used. In the recorded run it is the test driver replaying token A.

regions.label: Convex platform
regions.summary: The deployment. It signs each access token with the deployment's key, checks the token on every request before the app's function runs, runs the scheduler, and commits each function's writes in one transaction.

regions.label: App backend
regions.summary: The app's own Convex functions. setupConvexAuth and setupUsernamePassword generate the auth:* functions; users:createUser is the app's callback that creates the user row.

regions.label: auth
regions.summary: The core component: sessions and refresh tokens. It knows no sign-in method; it only sees opaque user ids.

regions.label: authPassword
regions.summary: Stores one argon2id password hash per user id and verifies passwords, rate limited by its child component.

regions.label: rateLimiter
regions.summary: Child component of authPassword. Counts password attempts so a guesser is slowed down.

regions.label: authUsername
regions.summary: Maps usernames to user ids. A username belongs to one user at most; it compares the normalized form.

functions.name: auth:signUpWithUsernamePassword
functions.summary: Creates a user with a username and a password, and signs them in.

functions.name: auth:signInWithUsernamePassword
functions.summary: Checks a username and a password and, if they match, starts a session.

functions.name: auth:refreshSession
functions.summary: Trades a refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token.

functions.name: auth:isAuthenticated
functions.summary: Whether the caller's access token is accepted and its session is live.

functions.name: users:createUser
functions.summary: The app's callback that inserts the row of a new user and returns its id.

functions.name: public._internal_dangerous_signUp
functions.summary: Records a new user id and creates its first session and refresh token.

functions.name: public._internal_dangerous_signIn
functions.summary: Creates a session for a user id that a sign-in method has already authenticated.

functions.name: public.refresh
functions.summary: Redeems a refresh token: issues the next one, spends the previous redeemed one, and revokes the session if a spent token comes back.

functions.name: public.getSession
functions.summary: Reads a session, if it is still live.

functions.name: sessions.deleteSessionTokens
functions.summary: Scheduled after a session is deleted: deletes the refresh tokens of that session.

functions.name: public.verifyPassword
functions.summary: Checks a password against the stored hash, under the rate limit.

functions.name: public._internal_dangerous_setPassword
functions.summary: Hashes a password with argon2id and stores it for a user id.

functions.name: public.getUserIdByUsername
functions.summary: Looks up the user id that owns a username.

functions.name: public.setUsername
functions.summary: Gives a user id a username.

tables.name: users
tables.summary: The app's users. This app keeps no fields in the row.

tables.name: createdUserIds
tables.summary: The ids of the app users that the core created or signed in.

tables.name: ttlConfig
tables.summary: The session lifetimes the app last passed in, so background jobs know when a session expires. At most one row.

tables.name: sessions
tables.summary: One row per active session. Written only when the session is created or deleted.

tables.name: refreshTokens
tables.summary: Every refresh token a session handed out, by SHA-256 hash. issued → redeemed → spent. Presenting a spent token revokes the session.

tables.name: passwords
tables.summary: One argon2id hash per user id, in PHC string format.

tables.name: rateLimits
tables.summary: Token buckets of the rate limiter, one row per limited key.

tables.name: usernames
tables.summary: One row per user that has a username.
